title: finance
text:
finance

Alex: Hey finance — used the corporate card for an airport car service this morning. Ride was for me + a visiting partner (client). Receipt only shows a single charge in EUR and no per-person breakdown. Can we split on the expense so the client cost is billed to the project and the internal bit to my card?

Maria: Hi Alex — can you paste the photo/screenshot of the receipt and the EUR amount? Also need to know whether the client portion is billable to their PO or to our project budget.

Alex: Screenshot: https://files.redwood.example/receipts/IMG_2026_03_22.jpg Amount: €78.50 (card posted at €78.50, bank charged an extra €2.15 FX fee). Client asked us to cover their transfer share and bill it back later to their PO.

Tara: I’m fine approving the split for the client portion as billable to PROJ-42 (we’ll invoice later). Alex, put the client line as "billable client expense" and tag PROJ-42. :+1:

finance-bot: Automated note: For split charges we require (1) original receipt image, (2) participant list (name + company), (3) allocation amounts or percentages, (4) cost center/PO for billable portion. Missing FX fee handling: include card statement line if possible.

Alex: Participant list: Alex Chen (Redwood) / Jordan Lin (Acme Inc.). Propose 50/50 split => €39.25 charge each, and allocate FX fee to internal card (so full €2.15 on company side). Is that ok?

Maria: That works. Please create two expense lines in Expensify (or our expense portal):
- Line 1: Transportation — €39.25 — paid by corporate card — tag PROJ-42 — expense type: "Client billable"
- Line 2: Transportation — €39.25 + €2.15 FX fee = €41.40 — paid by corporate card — tag GL: 6102 — expense type: "Travel - employee"
Also attach the screenshot and include note "airport transfer split with Acme, client portion billed to PROJ-42".

Samir: Quick Q — if the client later decides not to reimburse, does PROJ-42 absorb it automatically or should we escalate to Elaine on Sales for PO confirmation?

Tara: If they don't reimburse, we escalate to Sales. For now Sales has verbal ok; please add a comment linking the Acme contact email.

Alex: Done — expense submitted with attachments and comment: "Jordan Lin (Acme) agreed to PO billing, contact jordan@acme.example". Submitted in portal: https://expenses.redwood.example/submit/2033502468

Maria: Received. I'll queue this for expense audit. Please keep the card statement screenshot handy in case the FX fee needs verification.

Alex: Will upload card statement snippet in 10m. Thanks everyone! :thumbsup:

finance-bot: Thread closed by finance-bot: next steps = audit queue -> invoice team if PO confirmed.
